title: Matching screen loads slowly on older Android phones
text:
## Problem

On older Android phones (for example, devices from 2021), the **Matching** screen takes 3 to 5 seconds to show suggested groups. On iOS it loads almost instantly.

## Notes

- Part of the delay comes from the API (see the 4-second response time issue in pairly-api)
- The app also draws every group card at once. We should load the first 5 cards and the rest while scrolling.

Reported by the Westbrook engineering study groups, via Tomas Rivera.
